worldcombat.skill.psyshock.summary: Compress the psychic wave into a solid telekinetic shard and hurl it: it flies straight, drops with distance, and on impact settles damage against the target's physical Defence and knocks it back, shattering into grit.
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.use.0: Fire a mid-range psychic blow that settles against physical Defence
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.use.1: Shove a frail target out of position
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.use.2: Finish a low-health target with the cheapest shot
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.description.0: Hurls the materialized shard up to %1$s blocks; on impact it settles %2$s special damage against the target's physical Defence.
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.description.1: The shard flies at %1$s blocks/tick with %2$s drop and a %3$s block hit radius; running out of range or hitting terrain counts as a miss.
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.description.2: A hit knocks the target back %1$s blocks and shatters the shard.
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.heavy.on: Heavy shard: power x1.22, knockback x1.6 and a faster drop for a harder blow, at the cost of x0.8 velocity, x0.85 reach, +3 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.heavy.off: Light shard: a longer, faster, near-drifting throw, at the cost of power and knockback.
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.growth.0: From level %1$s the shard rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.growth.1: From level %1$s the shard rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of knockback.
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.preference.he: On: power x1.22, knockback x1.6 and a faster drop for a harder blow, at the cost of x0.8 velocity, x0.85 reach, +3 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown. Off (light shard): a longer, faster, near-drifting throw with lighter power and knockback.
worldcombat.skill.psyshock.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the companion closes in before shaping a shard; larger values let it open from further away.
